notes.title: Title Change for Japanese Version & Demo Playable Range Expansion
notes.content:
[h2][h1]Title Change for the Japanese Version[/h1][/h2]
We have changed the title of the Japanese version of "The Little Witch and The Lost Memories" to "ちいさな魔女と失くした記憶."
Through this title change, we hope more players will be able to experience the charm of the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840621/b746a8819f426086e01f0b58fef4734118a98e74.png[/img]


In addition, the logo for the Chinese version has also been updated to reflect this change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840621/9818894ac153395138f99481a1a317636bc01526.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840621/9ac292c9be7f16f0b0d52660b59f9e528b0cb567.png[/img]


[h2]Demo Playable Range Expanded[/h2]
Now you can play up to the end of Chapter 2 in the demo. The full game is composed of three main chapters and a short final chapter. With the demo covering the game's midpoint, it's a perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the story and get a feel for the adventure ahead.
Additionally, progress in the demo will be synced with the full version, so after playing up to the middle in the demo, you can purchase the full version and continue where you left off.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]1.1.0 Update [/b]

[h2]Your guide in-game now has more advice to give you, so you don’t get lost[/h2]
The game’s narrative experience is our main focus in this game. For this reason, we have added a great deal of guide dialogue so that the player does not get lost in ‘where’ and ‘what’ to do when solving the game’s puzzles.

[h2]Improved puzzle-solving mechanics[/h2]
We improved several puzzle-solving mechanics and fixed some game behavior that could have added unnecessary trouble to the puzzles.

[h2]Some game graphics in the game have been updated[/h2]
We will continue to update the game graphics to make them even more beautiful and cute.

notes.title: 2024/08/02 Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]v1.0.3[/b]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze in Chapter 3, Episode 3 when played with certain screen settings.
[*] Fixed a problem where opening the menu at a specific timing could cause the game to freeze without stopping the conversation.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 2, Episode 2 where the duvet could be reacquired after finishing bed-making.
[/list]

This week, we prioritized addressing issues related to gameplay. We apologize for any inconvenience caused to players who experienced disruptions in their game progression.

We are planning to update the guide in the future. While there are no issues in progressing through the story with the current content, players may have varying experiences with the difficulty of the puzzles depending on their individual skills.

Therefore, we are considering how to enhance the guide while maintaining the enjoyment of the puzzle-solving aspect of the game and providing assistance to players who might get stuck. For example, we might implement phased conversations in the guide, allowing players to progress through the story without getting stuck on puzzles. However, creating these phased conversations may take some time.

We will continue to update the game to ensure a comfortable playing experience. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

[*] Fixed a problem where opening the menu at a specific timing could cause the game to freeze without stopping the conversation.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 2, Episode 2 where the duvet could be reacquired after finishing bed-making.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
・We have fixed an issue where the game would sometimes crash when switching items and actions on the point-and-click screen.
・Few graphical updates.
・The button selection graphic and sound has been updated. 
・The design of the cursor for the point-and-click screens has been updated.


Planned Updates:

Here's a sneak peek at the updates planned for future additions to the demo version.
Release dates for these updates are TBD.

・Chapter Selection: Allows players to resume from either the completed parts of the story or the next story episode based on your progression.
・Ms. Crow’s Advice: When you are stuck on a puzzle, you will be able to consult Ms. Crow for advice.
・Conversation Log: Ms. Crow will be able to let you review past conversations from the episode of the story you are playing in currently.
